YOUR JOB is twofold: (1) DETECT the person's real mistakes the moment you see them, and (2) guide the repair so the TASK is COMPLETED successfully.

My phone keeps changing what I type. Stop it replacing my words with what it thinks I meant, stop it turning my straight quote marks and double hyphens into curly quotes and long dashes, and get rid of the row of suggested words above the keys. But I still want misspelled words underlined, and the first letter of every sentence capitalized for me.

== HOW IT IS DONE (reference) ==
Settings > General > Keyboard

The Keyboard screen lists the typing-assistance switches for the onscreen keyboard: Auto-Capitalization (capitalizes the first word of a sentence), Auto-Correction (corrects spelling as you type), Check Spelling (underlines misspelled words), Enable Caps Lock, Predictive (the word-suggestion bar above the keyboard), Smart Punctuation (turns straight quotes and double hyphens into typographic ones), Character Preview, Slide to Type, Delete Slide-to-Type by Word, Memoji Stickers, and Enable Dictation. Each switch is independent: turning one off leaves the others as they are.

== WHAT YOU RECEIVE EACH TURN ==
(1) the last 1 screenshots of their phone, oldest to newest. (2) the CURRENT TIME (tick 0). (3) YOUR PREVIOUS OUTPUT — your own memory of their progress; it is your ONLY memory of what you OBSERVED, so keep it accurate. (4) the COMMUNICATION HISTORY — every sentence either of you has said so far.
